sources: EARN Project Design v2, Sections 6.6 and 8
_meta.note: Plan and gate definitions from the design doc. Gate states are updated by npm run sync-data when a gate file appears in results/; progress notes are hand-maintained.

weeks.work: Extract DenseNet-121 features. Check G0a on Day 2. Build the Tier A federated loop. Run FedAvg and Camp A on S1. Build split S2.
weeks.deliverable: Features saved; baseline numbers; G0a, G0b

progress.item: Tier A loop, FedAvg and Camp A implemented and unit-tested
G0b retry: more rounds, unfrozen last block

weeks.work: Attacks A1-A3 against FedAvg, robust rules and Camp A on S1 and S2, 3 seeds.
weeks.deliverable: Attack table; G1; S1/S2 framing decision

weeks.work: Implement EARN: clipping, evidence, coverage blend, slow-up/fast-down trust, capped weighting. Unit tests per step. In-memory ledger stub.
Full evaluation: all methods x all attacks x S1/S2 x 3 seeds. Ablations. Sensitivity of step size and threshold.
Smart contract on a local Hardhat chain: trust table, history hashes, max-step rule. Gas and latency. Tier B confirmation runs.
weeks.deliverable: Contract + overhead numbers; Tier B table

weeks.work: Figures, 6-8 page draft, updated synopsis, final literature re-check, clean repository.

gates.name: Evidence signal
gates.condition: Evidence e(k,c) ranks hospitals' true per-class counts with Spearman >= 0.7 on S1
gates.ifFails: One retry (bias row, or evidence averaged over 3 rounds); if still below 0.7, Fallback F1
gates.note: Evidence came out inverted: centres with no images of a disease showed the largest change. Retry decision pending with the team.

gates.name: Baseline quality
gates.condition: Tier A FedAvg reaches balanced accuracy >= 0.45
gates.ifFails: Unfreeze the last dense block and re-extract features. One retry.
gates.note: Balanced accuracy was still rising at round 40. A retry with more rounds and an unfrozen last dense block is in progress.

gates.name: Problem is real
gates.condition: On S1 or S2, under Camp A, attack A1 gives the attacker >= 2x its FedAvg weight on a rare row AND drops that class's F1 by >= 0.15, with balanced accuracy falling < 0.03

gates.name: EARN works
gates.condition: Under A1 and A2, EARN's rare-class F1 stays within 0.05 of no-attack; with no attack within 0.02 of Camp A and above FedAvg; honest centre 2 reaches trust >= 0.8
